replacement: Replace an entire {{name}} JSON value with the typed value after parsing JSON; do not interpolate strings into raw JSON.

diffusion_model.description: H3 FL2VA diffusion weight filename from the UNETLoader enumeration; match the installed H3 implementation and quantization backend.

text_encoder.description: H3-compatible text encoder filename from CLIPLoader; loader type remains minimax.

video_vae.description: H3 video VAE filename from VAELoader.

audio_vae.description: H3 audio VAE filename from VAELoader; not interchangeable with the video VAE.

first_frame.description: ComfyUI input-relative image name returned by upload or verified under its input directory; never a client-only absolute path.

prompt.description: One-shot visual motion and soundscape prompt anchored to Picture 1; describe only the intended duration.

width.description: Target width accepted by the installed MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo node.

height.description: Target height accepted by the installed MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo node.

length.description: H3 input frame-length parameter at native 24 fps; not the final 60 fps frame count.

seed.description: Explicit per-shot seed; use integer-safe JSON handling, not a floating-point conversion.

output_prefix.description: Unique ComfyUI output-relative prefix for this run and shot.

rife_model.description: RIFE model filename accepted by the installed RIFEInterpolation node.

portrait-10s.status: source-derived parameters; public adaptation not rerun

portrait-15s.status: length from a separately accelerated source graph; applying it to this graph is not rerun

binding_checks: 136.first_frame must equal [137, 0]; prompt-only reference text cannot replace this edge.
136 outputs 0 and 1 feed the guider and sampler respectively.
125 output 0 feeds both video and audio VAE decoders.
Every required node class, input, enum and model filename must exist in the target object_info before submission.
All placeholders must be resolved and integer parameters must remain JSON integers before submission.
